## Checklist

- [ ] An issue is linked above (`Refs #N` or `Closes #N`).
- [ ] I ran the checks in the README and they pass. For a post, that includes
      `hugo --minify --gc`, `scripts/check-output.sh` and `scripts/check-wording.sh`.
- [ ] I did not weaken, skip or narrow any check.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or `.env` files.
- [ ] No private data: no real callsign, grid square, employer, hostname, serial
      number or asset tag.
- [ ] Images have real alt text and sit beside the post's `index.md`.
- [ ] Affiliate links, if any, carry the disclosure.
- [ ] I never use the short form of cryptocurrency.
- [ ] If this change alters the architecture, a data flow, a secret, or a third party the
      site depends on, I updated the threat model in `docs/threat-model/` (or this change
      does none of those).
